1.alt: Illustrative example: a ticket moves from backlog to open once the human approves requirements and plan, then to in progress, testing and done; testing can send it back to in progress.
1.source:
flowchart LR
  backlog[Backlog] -->|human approves requirements + plan| open[Open]
  open -->|agent claims| prog[In progress]
  prog -->|code merged| test[Testing]
  test -->|human: done| done[Done]
  test -->|human: changes| prog
